description: The Figshare GeoGraphNetworks release provides 110 validated spatial graphs derived from road, rail and river shapefiles. Its current file inventory contains 220 JSON and Excel files: 56 US state, district and territory road graphs plus one national rail graph, and 52 tiled Great Britain road graphs plus one river graph. The article describes NetworkX-ready JSON objects, while the repository provides CC BY 4.0 rights. These graphs can initialize network connectivity in transport simulations, but they do not by themselves provide current traffic counts, speeds, capacities or service timetables. Source-map dates, topology conversion rules and country-specific tiling are limitations when treating graph edges as operational routes. A reviewer-assessed use is testing route redundancy or disruption propagation in national-scale network scenarios. model-sumo and model-cityflow are related transport simulators; no direct file import or capacity calibration was tested. A rejected round-one candidate treated this collection as single-study support. The public multi-network repository meets the current reuse rule. No graph file was downloaded.
